repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Adapt inference/conversion references after matching hardware/dependencies; obtain trusted weights and review their separate terms.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Bounded pinned README/manifest/tree and relevant source review; deeper components, security and runtime verification are demand-driven. Detailed asset records remain unchanged.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: Code uses MIT under LICENSE-CODE. Model use separately follows LICENSE-MODEL's DeepSeek agreement and use-based restrictions; README supports commercial use subject to those terms.
risk_notes: External weights and benchmark claims were not downloaded/reproduced. Hardware sizing, trusted checkpoint provenance and model terms need checking for a selected deployment. Conversion writes output checkpoint files.
